Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: "The hand that mocked them": decoupling AP-1 occupancy from its chromatin trace
ideas.description: After a transient stimulus, run parallel time courses of AP-1 protein levels (FOS/JUN immunofluorescence, degron-tagged reporters) and of chromatin state at AP-1 motifs (ATAC-seq, FOS/JUN CUT&RUN, H3K27ac). Memory is supported only if accessibility and enhancer marks persist long after AP-1 occupancy has decayed, just as the inscription outlasts the sculptor's hand.

ideas.title: "Look on my Works": restimulation latency as a readout of a stored trace
ideas.description: Stimulate, let the response fully subside, then restimulate at a range of intervals while imaging an AP-1 target reporter in single living cells to quantify response latency, amplitude, and responder fraction. Faster or larger second responses that decay as a function of the inter-stimulus interval give a quantitative memory half-life, read out by the second 'traveller'.

ideas.title: "Nothing beside remains": acute AP-1 erasure separating establishment from maintenance
ideas.description: Use dTAG or auxin-inducible degradation of FOS/JUN applied either during the initial stimulus or only afterward, during the putative memory window. Persistence of the trace despite post-hoc depletion would localize memory to chromatin, whereas its collapse would show memory is merely sustained AP-1 presence.

ideas.title: The pedestal that outlasts the king: a genomic recorder of past AP-1 activity
ideas.description: Engineer an AP-1-responsive enhancer driving a recombinase or base editor that writes a permanent DNA barcode when AP-1 fires, then read the written mark jointly with scRNA-seq or ATAC days later. This tests cell by cell whether a past AP-1 episode predicts present transcriptional and chromatin state independently of current AP-1 levels.

ideas.title: "Round the decay of that colossal Wreck": dilution versus erosion of the trace
ideas.description: Compare memory persistence in proliferating versus cell-cycle-arrested cells and assay AP-1 mitotic bookmarking by CUT&RUN on mitotic chromosomes, distinguishing stepwise loss per division from continuous chromatin turnover. Analyzing which sites survive versus crumble (motif strength, cooperating factors, CpG content, enhancer-promoter contacts) identifies the determinants of a durable memory trace.
